notes.title: New game court and additional game modes.
notes.content:
[h2]🏀 New Game Court![/h2]

We're always adding fresh content, and it's time to introduce a brand-new court! This one comes with a unique twist—[b]giant beach balls[/b]! They’re fun to push around but can quickly turn into obstacles in tight situations. Get ready for some chaotic, bouncy action!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44352183/2fb899064a49f9863f23b1f39641ea21d100b151.jpg[/img]

[h2]🎮 More Game Modes![/h2]

Since our last demo, we’ve added some new game modes! While co-op has always been a big part of the game, we wanted to bring more single-player action too.

[list]
[*] [b]Classic Mode [/b]– Race against the clock to hit the final score!
[*] [b]Time Trial Mode[/b] – Your aim controls the clock—make shots to add time, miss and it drains!
[*] [b]Boss Fight Mode[/b] – We’ll reveal more about this one in the next update! 👀
[/list]

[h2]🆕 New Demo Coming Soon![/h2]

A brand-new demo is on the way, so you’ll get to try out these exciting new modes yourself. Stay tuned for the release—we’ll let you know when it’s live!

notes.title: New gameplay mechanics including Stamina and Shot Blocking.
notes.content:
New update is here! This one is focused on technical stuff. The animation system was completely re-worked allowing for more fluid player movement and additional game mechanics.

[h3]New game mechanics[/h3]

Players now have stamina that allow you to run faster and catch the ball before your opponent does. You can also block other player shots now, but be carefull as they can do the same to you! To have success at blocking make sure you're in-front of the other player and press the jump button at the right time. Too early or too late and you won't succeed!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44352183/4b2248d5838c94daf3419e004ed55cca05c1f255.gif[/img]

[h3]Other changes and next update[/h3]

This update also brings lots of smaller tweaks and adjustments to improve the game. To name a few, you can see that we now have ball dispensing machines in the three point game. The tutorial was extended to explain the new game mechanics. UI was tweaked to not get in the way of player dunks and the hoop and board reacts to the ball impacts more to give even better game feel.

Now that the technical part of the game is improved, our future update will be focused on new content!

Can't say much yet, but watch out for the pidgeons!

notes.title: New game mode, new dress and new hair colour!
notes.content:
Welcome to our first game update! Thanks for all your support so far, we really appreciate your feedback and please don't forget to wishlist the game and tell your friends about it!

[h3]New Game Mode[/h3]

You can play a completely new game mode called the 3-point contest. In this game mode, your focus is solely on shooting from the 3-point line and trying to score more points than your opponents before the time runs out. Be careful with your timing, as the opponent's balls can disrupt your perfect shot!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44352183/a2f6a60e446f38bbaddc3b8a3fe12fceb0b7fe8f.png[/img]

[h3]New Team Dress and Hair Colour[/h3]

We also added new dress and new hair colour to add more variety to the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44352183/2a72b0a10b686499f3ab7135fdc05fa64d9c9b2e.png[/img]
